 .;This routine contains the input transform logic for the 'DT' field (#10) of the
 .;EXAMINATION file (#393).
 .;
 .;Delimiters for protection have been removed.
 .
b9e64dff: ; Call the ^DIE entry point to handle field input
e100f80e: ; Initialize loop through multiple-valued field.
6dc85237: ; Extract REVIEWED BY and DATE REVIEWED from field
a9d87033: ; Set up prompt for input
f93ac180: ; Disable editing for identifier fields
99580abf: ; Read input value, timing out and setting X=U on timeout
e18f4412: If no input, set X to null and branch based on DV: Quit if DV doesn't contain 'R', set X to null if DV is null, set X to null if D'>0 (date is in the future), or go to A (Ask).
6b8d8425: If input starts with '?', go to QS (Query String). If input starts with '^', execute D (Delete) and branch to routine ^DIE17.
d92676d6: If input is '@', execute D (Delete) and branch to routine Z^DIE2.

bef877ce: If input is a space, DV contains 'd' (Default), DV doesn't contain 'P' (Prompt), and a default value exists for the current field label in the USER file, set X to the default value. If DV doesn't contain 'D' (Display) or 'S' (Store), write the default value.

0fe882df: Branch based on DV: If DV is null, go to M^DIE17. If DV contains 'V', go to ^DIE3. If DV doesn't contain 'S', go to P (Prompt). If the VARIABLE POINTER field (.01) exists for the current file and field, execute its code. If X is a name component, execute SET (sets DIR(0) for ^DIR). If DIC('S') exists, execute the DIC('S') code. If no DB(DQ) exists, write the processed value. Go to V (Validate).
e643e7e1: Kill DDER and go to X (eXit).

cde46aab: If DV contains 'P' (Prompt), set DIC to the file/subfile number, set DIC(0) to 'ENM' or 'ELM' based on whether DB(DQ) exists, set DLAYGO if the 'P' crossref has a second piece. If DV doesn't contain '*', execute ^DIC to get Y=IEN. Set X=+Y and DIC=DIE. Go to X if X<0.
75b8c6bd: If DV doesn't contain 'N' (Numeric), execute D (Delete). If length of decimal portion of X > 24, kill X and go to Z (eXit).
1f0cd17b: If DQ(DQ) 5th piece doesn't contain '$', X is numeric with leading '-', and DQ(DQ) 5th piece contains '+X'=X', convert X to numeric.
ccfddf3c: Execute 'X'_DQ (X1, X2, etc.) code and kill YS.
5597782b: Kill DIC('S') and DLAYGO. If X exists and is not null, set DG(DW)=X. If DV contains 'd', set ^DISV(DUZ,'DIE',DLB)=X. Go to A (Ask).
eced706b: If not in Volume Set Editing, write '??' and bell. If DB(DQ) exists, go to Z^DIE17.
8303f070: Set DZ=X, execute D (Delete), execute QQ^DIEQ, and go to B (Branch).
f5351395: Set D=DIFLD, DQ(DQ)=DLB_U_DV_U_DU_U_DW_U_'X'_DQ code title.
